title: 주간 생산량 추이 (3~8월)
code:
import numpy as np
# Get x and y data from the plot objects
# For bar charts, ax.patches contains the bars. We can get their heights.
heights = [p.get_height() for p in ax.patches]
# The x positions are usually 0, 1, 2... corresponding to the categories
x_positions = np.arange(len(heights))

# Identify which weeks correspond to which indices based on the sorted order of '주차'
# Since '주차' is numeric and likely sorted ascending by default in bar charts:
# Index 0 -> Week 1, Index 1 -> Week 2, ..., Index 12 -> Week 13, Index 13 -> Week 14...

mask1 = x_positions <= 12  # Weeks 1-13 (indices 0-12)
mask2 = x_positions >= 13  # Weeks 14-26 (indices 13-25)

mean1 = np.mean([h for h, m in zip(heights, mask1) if m]) if mask1.any() else 0
mean2 = np.mean([h for h, m in zip(heights, mask2) if m]) if mask2.any() else 0

ax.axhline(mean1, color='blue', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, label=f'1~13주 평균 ({mean1:.1f})')
ax.axhline(mean2, color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, label=f'14~26주 평균 ({mean2:.1f})')
ax.legend(loc='upper right')
